## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 175 retinal image captures during November 2019. This activity represents the total number of examinations recorded for the month. The service should continue to monitor capture volumes through routine operational review and ensure that any issues affecting the imaging process are identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. This result should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s ongoing quality assurance activity, with attention given to image acquisition and any recurring technical difficulties. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 30 referable results. The median wait from photograph to grade was 2 days. These results should continue to be monitored through the usual clinical and operational processes, with grading timeliness reviewed alongside image quality and referral outcomes. Overall, the monthly report provides a basis for maintaining oversight of activity, image quality, and the timely completion of grading at Central Eye Clinic.
